court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: State Rep. by The Inspector of Police .…. Respondent.
advocates: For Respondent: Mr. M. Mohamed Riyaz, Additional Public Prosecutor
prayer: PRAYER: Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C, to direct the learned Principal Sessions Judge, Special Court Tiruvallur to consider the bail application of the petitioner on the same day of the surrender Crime No. 498 of 2019 on the file The Inspector of Police, Periyapalayam, Tiruvallur District.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

P. Rajamanickam, J.:— This petition has been filed seeking a direction, to direct the learned Principal Sessions Judge, Special Court Tiruvallur to consider the bail application of the petitioner on the same day of the surrender Crime No. 498 of 2019 on the file The Inspector of Police, Periyapalayam, Tiruvallur District.

2. In view of the amendments made in the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, this Court is of the view that the usual directions that were issued by this Court cannot be issued routinely in all cases. Therefore, the petitioner is directed to surrender before the trial Court within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and on such surrender, the learned Principal Sessions Judge, Special Court Tiruvallur District shall deal with the matter on the same day on merits and in accordance with law, after issuing notice to the victims under Section 15(A) of the SC/ST Act.

3. This Criminal Original Petition is disposed of with the above directions.
